values.note: Huron County Parks: full hookup $50 a night; rustic (tent-camping area, sites 55-64) $31, left out of the base; each +$5 on holidays and -$5 in the off season. Seasonal full-hookup sites $2,500. One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split posted). $15 cancellation fee.

fees.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-county-park ('Full Hookup $50 per night + $5 Holidays -$5 Off Season Discount; Rustic $31 ...; Seasonal $2,500 Full Hookup'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-county-park ('Open May 1 - October 15') + https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-park-reservations ('Park Open May 1 - Oct 15'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-county-park ('Full Hookup' sites) + park map (legend 'Full Hookup'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 54 full-hookup sites (1-54) and 10 sites in a separate tent-camping circle (55-64), per the park map (rev. 1/24). Tents are allowed on any site, one camping unit per site.

sites.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/wp-content/uploads/Sebewaing-Park-Map-2024.pdf (sites 1-54 Full Hookup, 55-64 Tent Camping) + https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-county-park ('only 1 camping unit is allowed per campsite'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Free showers. No Wi-Fi at the park (the library half a mile away has it).

facilities.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-county-park ('Bath houses with free showers and flush toilets are available'; 'There is no Wi-Fi at the park') + park map ('Dump Station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online through Huron County Parks' Checkfront page ('Book a Site') or by phone. The next season opens to the public around December 1 (2026 season: Dec 1, 2025, noon). Refunds only 30+ days out and not for holidays or special events. Seasonal sites are limited and sell out each year.

booking.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-park-reservations ('2026 Reservations Open to the General Public on Monday, Dec. 1 at 12pm (Noon) EST'; Checkfront 'Book a Site') + https://huroncountyparks.com/sebewaing-county-park (cancellation and seasonal text), read 2026-10-22

note: Huron County park at 759 Union St, on the Sebewaing River at the end of Union St (drains to Saginaw Bay/Lake Huron), on 40 acres with a fishing dock and three nature trails; no boat launch at the park (the marina is a few miles away). Operated by Huron County Parks -- a DISTINCT campground from the private Sebewaing River Campground (id3849) at 541 Union St. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the county's pages: full hookup $50 (rustic/tent $31 left out of the base), season May 1-Oct 15, 64 sites (54 full hookup + 10 tent, park map), water/sewer, reservable online, phone (989) 883-2033. Added Checkfront url, Dec 1 booking opening, free showers/flush toilets/dump, no Wi-Fi. Amperage (30/50, derived) not stated on the pages; left. Note cleaned of price/site/season/booking text the fields hold. Seasonal full-hookup sites exist ($2,500, 'limited number') but their share is not stated.
